XTextAppend preserves all three ordered direct bases XText, XParagraphAppend and XTextPortionAppend; XTextContentAppend remains independent as upstream. Normal cppumaker static MI metadata, implicit root versus explicit parents, cache identity and deprecated getters reuse actual shared CPPU/typelib owners, with no inferred interface/type/default provider. These are actual SDK contracts and normal static type bindings, not concrete Writer text services or a fake component. Normal reflection remains incomplete as upstream normal generation specifies. Actual SwXText/SwXTextRange/SwXTextCursor raw-object boundaries still require migration to native UNO Reference/Sequence ownership and original concrete helper/class responsibilities. Physical C++ multiple-inheritance ABI, threads, comprehensive reflection and compiled native whole-module differential parity remain unverified. Real table managers/model application, full DOCX/XLSX import/export and existing desktop/mobile UI workflows remain incomplete. Broad parity/default/verified flags stay false.
